External Tasks

General Concept: External Tasks in BPMN represent activities that interact with external systems, such as Service Tasks, Send Tasks, and Message Events. These elements manage the execution and integration of work outside the process engine, ensuring correct input/output mapping, error handling, and variable scoping. Typically the work is executed by Job Workers which listen for external tasks to be executed and execute them as soon as they are ready for it.

  • Service Task
  • Send Task
  • Message End Event
  • Message Intermediate Throw Event

Usage & Options in TaktX:
External Tasks in TaktX:

  • Support input and output variable mapping using FEEL expressions.
  • Can be executed synchronously or asynchronously.
  • Allow for error handling, retries, and compensation.
  • Support escalation, boundary events, and timeouts for robust integration.
  • Integrate with REST APIs, messaging systems, or custom adapters.
  • Provide monitoring, audit logging, and client integration for external interactions.
